topic: Cut a versioned release with tags, changelog and GitHub release notes

defects.detail: SKILL.md links to references/release-process.md which itself links to references/versioning-rules.md; the semver bump rules should be directly in SKILL.md or only in versioning-rules.md, not nested across multiple files
section contains dated conditional: 'Before March 2026 use the legacy gh release syntax'; dated conditions become obsolete and cause confusion
inconsistent terminology: 'release tags' (line 8), 'version tag' (line 21), and 'release tag' (line 13) used interchangeably for the same concept
